text: BAM share fell 0.21 percentage points over 24 hours and 0.13 percentage points over 7 days, leaving 34.4% of Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 21.8% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The latest top-node change is best read as whale-driven routing, not structural rollover; the only validated structural rollover was in fra on 2026-06-24 with 22 minutes of lead time.
